assign.layer: Spark UI, Status Store and Metrics

newLayers.name: Status Store Protobuf Serializers
newLayers.description: Serializers that convert status store objects (job, stage, executor and application data, accumulables, executor metrics) to and from protobuf messages so the KVStore can persist them for the history server.

appendDesc.Spark UI, Status Store and Metrics: Also covers the REST API resources and enums under status/api/v1 (applications, stages, Prometheus), the paged table helper, RDD operation graph, storage page and tab, tool tips, the app status source and the history server plugin hook.

tour.title: REST API: from resource class to status store
tour.description: ApiRootResource dispatches to resource classes such as ApplicationListResource and StagesResource. They read data from AppStatusStore, convert it to the api.scala classes, and JacksonMessageWriter writes it as JSON. PrometheusResource exposes executor metrics in the Prometheus text format.
